subject.name: ProofBench Seam Check (T9) on PG4 canonical fixtures — certified checker arm

method.procedure: T9 seam check at native resolution on pg4-clean-tile.png and pg4-shifted-tile.png (256x256), worse axis rules, as recorded 2026-11-17

measurements.name: clean_vertical_wrap_ratio
measurements.target: CLEANLY band: wrap ratio <= 1.5 and dE00 excess <= 1.0

measurements.name: clean_vertical_de_excess
measurements.target: CLEANLY band: wrap ratio <= 1.5 and dE00 excess <= 1.0

measurements.name: clean_horizontal_wrap_ratio
measurements.target: CLEANLY band: wrap ratio <= 1.5 and dE00 excess <= 1.0

measurements.name: clean_horizontal_de_excess
measurements.target: CLEANLY band: wrap ratio <= 1.5 and dE00 excess <= 1.0

measurements.name: shifted_vertical_wrap_ratio
measurements.target: FAILS band (by construction: right half rolled 40 px)

measurements.name: shifted_horizontal_wrap_ratio
measurements.target: CLEANLY band: wrap ratio <= 1.5 and dE00 excess <= 1.0

measurements.name: shifted_horizontal_de_excess
measurements.target: CLEANLY band: wrap ratio <= 1.5 and dE00 excess <= 1.0

verdict.outcome: CLEANLY (clean fixture), FAILS (shifted fixture) — both as constructed

limitations: Baseline transcribed from the Nov 17 acceptance record, not re-measured on that date by this run.
The live hosted app arm of the Nov 17 baseline is a separate implementation and is not covered by this record.
